segments.text: Which college running backs are most likely to become NFL RB1s? Here's what our model says.
Number three: J'Koby Williams, Texas Tech. A twenty percent chance at a top twelve season in his first five years.
Number two: Jadan Baugh, Florida. Twenty one percent.
Number one: Cole Tabb, Cincinnati. Twenty six percent. A hundred thirty one scrimmage yards a game, and he catches passes.
Only about one in six drafted running backs ever has an RB1 season.
